title: Browns put LB Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah on PUP list

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Browns put LB Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah on PUP list
sources.description: Word in February was that it was doubtful that Browns linebacker Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah will ever play again and the team made a roster move that rules him out for the 2026 season on Friday.
